text:
Maya Chen: Quick poll — volunteer to be the 'Dessert Pantry Rep' for the next 4 weeks? Responsibilities: reorder snacks, manage leftovers, and pick one weekly treat. Nominate yourself or vote with emoji. :cookie: = yes, :no_entry_sign: = pass
Omar Patel: I nominate @Alex G :cookie:
Alex G: I'll take it! can do a weekly cookie rota. :raised_hands:
Lena S: +1 for Alex :cookie:
Jordan: Happy to sub if Alex needs backup. :thumbsup:
Maya Chen: Tally so far: Alex (3), Jordan (1). Any more volunteers?
Sam Rivera: I can cover one week a month if that helps. :ok_hand:
Alex G: Cool — I'll make a tiny shared doc with a $25/week budget and a quick dietary prefs section. Will DM kitchen about storage.
DevBot: Reminder: please log any office purchases in /shared/office/expenses within 48h to keep accounting happy. (automated)
Maya Chen: Consensus seems clear. Alex, you're the Dessert Pantry Rep for the next 4 weeks. Thanks! :tada:
Alex G: Thanks everyone! Quick follow-up: chocolate chip vs lemon cookies for week 1? React with :choc: for chocolate chip or :lemon: for lemon.
Lena S: :choc:
Omar Patel: :choc:
Jordan: :lemon:
Sam Rivera: :choc:
Maya Chen: Chocolate chip wins. Alex, you're officially authorized to purchase up to $25 this week. Please post the order link when done. :smile:
Alex G: Will do. I'll post the order and the shared doc in #random when it's set up. Thanks for the vote!
